headline: Trump's Face Goes on the Dollar

beats.text: The US Mint just put Trump's face on a new dollar coin for America's two-hundred-fiftieth birthday.
First sitting president in a century on US currency.

beats.caption: there is no actual gold in the coin
beats.label: via WION

beats.text: Fitting — it broke a real rule too. Federal law generally keeps living people off US money.

beats.caption: US law generally prohibits portraits of living people on coins
beats.label: via WION

beats.text: A separate law bars living presidents from this series. So how'd he get on it? A loophole.

beats.caption: has cited a 2020 law as the legal basis for this design
beats.label: via WION

beats.text: That 2020 law bans living faces off the back of these coins, never the front — right where his is. Columnist Catherine Rampell joked it marks liberty's birth in seventeen seventy-six, its death in twenty twenty-six.
